Thanks for the tag, Tessa. Finance intake here — we can support a provisional credit cap for the short window with these conditions:

1) We need the formal PO (received) and a signed amendment stating the staged remit and payment triggers.
2) For VAT routing to HealthSys B.V.: please provide company registration (Chamber of Commerce extract) and the VAT certificate (VAT ID visible).
3) Credit cap mechanics: we can provision a EUR 150,000 provisional cap for 90 days, subject to weekly invoice reporting and the right to pause further shipments if aging exceeds agreed triggers (60 days past due on any tranche).
4) Accounting needs an explicit remit plan: invoice 1 (30%) Net45 from issue, invoice 2 (40%) Net45 from issue + conditional milestone (systems-onboarded), invoice 3 (30%) Net90 or on final acceptance. We prefer Net45 rather than Net30 for the larger tranches given internal cycles.

If HealthSys needs Net30 on the first tranche specifically, we can consider splitting the first tranche into two smaller invoices to preserve cashflow while preserving governance.

Laura — happy to have legal keep the amendment tight; I'll draft finance-approved language and share. Tessa — once we have the doc, finance will circulate the DocuSign link and enable the provisional cap in our billing system.

-Marissa Cole
Dir., Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
